verdict.rationale: Fly.io's documented product design explicitly supports running Machines 'close to your users' across many regions with fast boot times (fly-io-docs-14), which is core to its edge-compute pitch. However, extensive community evidence reports frequent regional outages, unreliable networking, and stuck/unreachable instances, undermining consistent delivery of a reliable global edge presence (fly-io-comm-1,2,5,6,7,9,17,19).
